facts.fact: The Nouakchott Data Centre (Centre de Donnees de Nouakchott), a state facility of 1,372 sq m and 100 racks, was inaugurated by the President on 2025-05-08, marking the start of operation, offering in-country cloud hosting, backup and disaster recovery to public administrations, financial institutions, startups and service providers (AMI).

AMI states the Nouakchott Data Centre, in service from its 2025-05-08 inauguration, holds a Level 3 (Tier III) certification (attributed to an 'AppTime Global Institute', apparently the Uptime Institute) with availability above 99.982 percent.

facts.fact: The Nouakchott Data Center is presented as the first national facility, inaugurated by the President and financed with EUR 15 million from the EIB, with the ministry of digital transformation speaking for it.
The Nouakchott Data Center offers hosting and backup services to public administrations, financial institutions, startups and service providers.
The Nouakchott Data Center holds a level 3 certification with over 99.982% availability.
Minister said all government servers were moved into a data centre the ministry created, hosting data of various government sectors.
